source_row.rationale: Abdominal distention, nausea, and absence of bowel sounds/flatus following abdominal surgery are classic signs of postoperative ileus, a temporary impairment of normal bowel motility. While mild ileus is common after abdominal surgery, persistent or worsening symptoms warrant further assessment, since prolonged ileus can lead to complications and may occasionally indicate a more serious issue such as mechanical obstruction.
